description: Change a monitor's name, grace period, slow threshold, webhook or visibility. Only the fields you pass change.

id.description: Monitor id, as returned by create_monitor.

manage_token.description: The monitor's manage_token (returned once by create_monitor).

slow_tps_threshold.description: Tokens/sec floor, or null to clear.

webhook_url.description: https:// webhook, or null to clear.

name: update_monitor
title: Update monitor settings
